description: This file defines mock classes for the IControl and IControlFactory interfaces used in the Rialto control component, utilizing Google Mock for unit testing.

classes.name: ControlFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IControlFactory interface, used to create mock control objects in tests.

classes.name: ControlMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IControl interface, providing mocked methods for unit testing control client registration.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance (mocked).

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a control client with the control mock, returning true if successful.
